project_type: Node/Express + vanilla JS PWA, Polish UI. Demo mode (OFFLINE_MODE) serves an in-memory store; production uses MySQL (mysql2). Static assets from public/.
language: JavaScript (CommonJS on the server, classic <script> IIFEs in the browser; dual-module files like public/chat-reactions.js, pluralize-pl.js, notification-text.js)
build_system: No build step for JS/CSS (package.json 'build' is an echo). Assets are linked with ?v=N query strings and precached by public/sw.js (cache-first keyed by FULL URL incl. ?v). Windows + PowerShell: chain with ';' not '&&'. Repo is on OneDrive: retry on 'cloud file provider exited unexpectedly'.
